content: 『是的，殿下！』比丘們！御車手回答毘婆尸王子後，驅車去那位死者處。

original: Addasā kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro petaṃ kālaṅkataṃ, disvā sārathiṃ āmantesi–
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸王子看見已故的死者。

original: ‘ kiṃ panāyaṃ, samma sārathi, kālaṅkato nāmā’ ti?
content: 『親愛的御車手！那麼，怎樣這位名為死者？』

original: ‘ Eso kho, deva, kālaṅkato nāma.
content: 『殿下！這位名為死者，

original: Na dāni taṃ dakkhanti mātā vā pitā vā aññe vā ñātisālohitā, sopi na dakkhissati mātaraṃ vā pitaraṃ vā aññe vā ñātisālohite’ ti.
content: 現在，母親或父親或其他親族血親看不到他，他也將看不到母親或父親或其他親族血親。』

original: ‘ Kiṃ pana, samma sārathi, ahampi maraṇadhammo maraṇaṃ anatīto;
content: 『親愛的御車手！那麼，我也是死法者，未超越死者，

original: mampi na dakkhanti devo vā devī vā aññe vā ñātisālohitā;
content: 陛下或皇后或其他親族血親看不到我，

original: ahampi na dakkhissāmi devaṃ vā deviṃ vā aññe vā ñātisālohite’ ti?
content: 我也看不到陛下或皇后或其他親族血親嗎？』

original: ‘ Tvañca, deva, mayañcamha sabbe maraṇadhammā maraṇaṃ anatītā;
content: 『殿下！你與我們全部是死法者，未超越死者，

original: tampi na dakkhanti devo vā devī vā aññe vā ñātisālohitā;
content: 陛下或皇后或其他親族血親看不到你，

original: tvampi na dakkhissasi devaṃ vā deviṃ vā aññe vā ñātisālohite’ ti.
content: 你也將看不到陛下或皇后或其他親族血親。』

original: ‘ Tena hi, samma sārathi, alaṃ dānajja uyyānabhūmiyā, itova antepuraṃ paccaniyyāhī’ ti.
content: 『親愛的御車手！那樣的話，今天、現在，在遊樂園上夠了！請你就從這裡朝內宮出發。』

original: ‘ Evaṃ, devā’ ti kho, bhikkhave, sārathi vipassissa kumārassa paṭissutvā tatova antepuraṃ paccaniyyāsi.
content: 『是的，殿下！』比丘們！御車手回答毘婆尸王子後，就從那裡朝內宮出發。

original: Tatra sudaṃ, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro antepuraṃ gato dukkhī dummano pajjhāyati–
content: 比丘們！在那裡，到達內宮的毘婆尸王子痛苦地、不快樂地深思：

original: ‘ dhiratthu kira, bho, jāti nāma, yatra hi nāma jātassa jarā paññāyissati, byādhi paññāyissati, maraṇaṃ paññāyissatī’ ti.
content: 『唉！先生！看起來出生確實是討厭，確實是因為出生者的老必將被知道；病必將被知道；死必將被知道。』(50)

original: 51.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā sārathiṃ āmantāpetvā etadavoca–
content: 那時，邦都馬國王召喚御車手後，說這個：

original: ‘ kacci, samma sārathi, kumāro uyyānabhūmiyā abhiramittha, kacci, samma sārathi, kumāro uyyānabhūmiyā attamano ahosī’ ti?
content: 『親愛的御車手！是否王子在遊樂園極喜樂呢？親愛的御車手！是否王子在遊樂園是悅意的呢？』

original: ‘ Na kho, deva, kumāro uyyānabhūmiyā abhiramittha, na kho, deva, kumāro uyyānabhūmiyā attamano ahosī’ ti.
content: 『陛下！王子在遊樂園不極喜樂，陛下！王子在遊樂園是不悅意的。』

original: ‘ Kiṃ pana, samma sārathi, addasa kumāro uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanto’ ti?
content: 『親愛的御車手！那麼，當王子被帶到遊樂園時，看見什麼呢？』

original: ‘ Addasā kho, deva, kumāro uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanto mahājanakāyaṃ sannipatitaṃ nānārattānañca dussānaṃ vilātaṃ kayiramānaṃ.
content: 『陛下！當王子被帶到遊樂園時，看見集合的大群人，與種種染色布匹的擔架被做著。

original: Disvā maṃ etadavoca–
content: 看見後，對我說這個：

original: ‘‘ kiṃ nu kho, so , samma sārathi, mahājanakāyo sannipatito nānārattānañca dussānaṃ vilātaṃ kayiratī’’ ti?
content: 「親愛的御車手！為什麼集合的大群人，與種種染色布匹的擔架被做呢？」

original: ‘‘ Eso kho, deva, kālaṅkato nāmā’’ ti.
content: 「殿下！這位名為死者。」

original: ‘‘ Tena hi, samma sārathi, yena so kālaṅkato tena rathaṃ pesehī’’ ti.
content: 「親愛的御車手！那樣的話，請你驅車去那位死者處。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ devā’’ ti kho ahaṃ, deva, vipassissa kumārassa paṭissutvā yena so kālaṅkato tena rathaṃ pesesiṃ.
content: 「是的，殿下！」陛下！我回答毘婆尸王子後，驅車去那位死者處。

original: Addasā kho, deva, kumāro petaṃ kālaṅkataṃ, disvā maṃ etadavoca–
content: 陛下！毘婆尸王子看見已故的死者。看見後，對我說這個：

original: ‘‘ kiṃ panāyaṃ, samma sārathi, kālaṅkato nāmā’’ ti ?
content: 「親愛的御車手！那麼，怎樣這位名為死者？」

original: ‘‘ Eso kho, deva, kālaṅkato nāma.
content: 「殿下！這位名為死者，

original: Na dāni taṃ dakkhanti mātā vā pitā vā aññe vā ñātisālohitā, sopi na dakkhissati mātaraṃ vā pitaraṃ vā aññe vā ñātisālohite’’ ti.
content: 現在，母親或父親或其他親族血親看不到他，他也將看不到母親或父親或其他親族血親。」

original: ‘‘ Kiṃ pana, samma sārathi, ahampi maraṇadhammo maraṇaṃ anatīto;
content: 「親愛的御車手！那麼，我也是死法者，未超越死者，

original: mampi na dakkhanti devo vā devī vā aññe vā ñātisālohitā;
content: 陛下或皇后或其他親族血親看不到我，

original: ahampi na dakkhissāmi devaṃ vā deviṃ vā aññe vā ñātisālohite’’ ti?
content: 我也看不到陛下或皇后或其他親族血親嗎嗎？」

original: ‘‘ Tvañca, deva, mayañcamha sabbe maraṇadhammā maraṇaṃ anatītā;
content: 「殿下！你與我們全部是死法者，未超越死者，

original: tampi na dakkhanti devo vā devī vā aññe vā ñātisālohitā, tvampi na dakkhissasi devaṃ vā deviṃ vā aññe vā ñātisālohite’’ ti.
content: 陛下或皇后或其他親族血親看不到我，我也看不到陛下或皇后或其他親族血親。」

original: ‘‘ Tena hi, samma sārathi, alaṃ dānajja uyyānabhūmiyā, itova antepuraṃ paccaniyyāhī’ ti.
content: 「親愛的御車手！那樣的話，今天、現在，在遊樂園上夠了！請你就從這裡朝內宮出發。」

original: ‘‘‘ Evaṃ, devā’’ ti kho ahaṃ, deva, vipassissa kumārassa paṭissutvā tatova antepuraṃ paccaniyyāsiṃ.
content: 「是的，殿下！」陛下！我回答王子後，就從那裡朝內宮出發。

original: So kho, deva, kumāro antepuraṃ gato dukkhī dummano pajjhāyati–
content: 陛下！在那裡，到達內宮的毘婆尸王子痛苦地、不快樂地深思：

original: ‘‘ dhiratthu kira bho jāti nāma, yatra hi nāma jātassa jarā paññāyissati, byādhi paññāyissati, maraṇaṃ paññāyissatī’’’ ti.
content: 「唉！先生！看起來出生確實是討厭，確實是因為出生者的老必將被知道；病必將被知道；死必將被知道。」』(51)

original: Pabbajito
content: 出家者

original: 52.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumassa rañño etadahosi–
content: 那時，邦都馬國王想這個：

original: ‘ mā heva kho vipassī kumāro na rajjaṃ kāresi, mā heva vipassī kumāro agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji, mā heva nemittānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ assa vacanan’ ti.
content: 『不要就使毘婆尸王子不作國王，不要毘婆尸王子就從在家出家成為無家者，不要占相婆羅門們就會有真實的言語。』

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa bhiyyosomattāya pañca kāmaguṇāni upaṭṭhāpesi–
content: 比丘們，那時，邦都馬國王更對毘婆尸王子服侍五種欲：

original: ‘ yathā vipassī kumāro rajjaṃ kareyya, yathā vipassī kumāro na agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya, yathā nemittānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ micchā assa vacanan’ ti.
content: 『如是，毘婆尸王子會作國王，如是，毘婆尸王子不會從在家出家成為無家者，如是，占相婆羅門們會有錯誤的言語。』

original: ‘ ‘ Tatra sudaṃ, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreti.
content: 比丘們！在那裡，毘婆尸王子賦有、擁有天的五種欲自娛。

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro bahūnaṃ vassānaṃ bahūnaṃ vassasatānaṃ bahūnaṃ vassasahassānaṃ accayena sārathiṃ āmantesi–
content: 比丘們！那時，經過好幾年、好幾百年、好幾千年，毘婆尸王子召喚御車手：

original: ‘ yojehi, samma sārathi, bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni, uyyānabhūmiṃ gacchāma subhūmidassanāyā’ ti.
content: 『親愛的御車手！請你準備一輛輛吉祥車，我們去遊樂園看美景。』

original: ‘ Evaṃ, devā’ ti kho, bhikkhave, sārathi vipassissa kumārassa paṭissutvā bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojetvā vipassissa kumārassa paṭivedesi–
content: 『是的，殿下！』比丘們！御車手回答毘婆尸王子後，準備一輛輛吉祥車後，回報毘婆尸王子：

original: ‘ yuttāni kho te, deva, bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni, yassa dāni kālaṃ maññasī’ ti.
content: 『殿下！你的一輛輛吉祥車已準備，現在是那個你考量的時間。』

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro bhaddaṃ bhaddaṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyāsi.
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸王子登上一輛吉祥車後，以一輛輛吉祥車向遊樂園出發。(52)

original: 53.‘‘ Addasā kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanto purisaṃ bhaṇḍuṃ pabbajitaṃ kāsāyavasanaṃ.
content: 比丘們！向遊樂園出發的毘婆尸王子看見年看見剃光頭的、出家的、穿[[kāsāyāni vatthāni#袈裟衣]]的男子。

original: Disvā sārathiṃ āmantesi–
content: 看見後，召喚御車手：

original: ‘ ayaṃ pana, samma sārathi, puriso kiṃkato?
content: 『親愛的御車手！那麼，這位男子怎麼了？

original: Sīsaṃpissa na yathā aññesaṃ, vatthānipissa na yathā aññesan’ ti?
content: 他的頭不如同其他人的，他的衣服也不如同其他人的。』

original: ‘ Eso kho, deva, pabbajito nāmā’ ti.
content: 『殿下！這位名為出家者。』

original: ‘ Kiṃ paneso, samma sārathi, pabbajito nāmā’ ti?
content: 『親愛的御車手！那麼，怎樣這位名為出家者？』

original: ‘ Eso kho, deva, pabbajito nāma sādhu dhammacariyā sādhu samacariyā[ sammacariyā( ka.)] sādhu kusalakiriyā[ kusalacariyā( syā.)] sādhu puññakiriyā sādhu avihiṃsā sādhu bhūtānukampā’ ti.
content: 『殿下！這位名為出家者，有好的法行、好的正行、好的善行為、好的福業、好的無加害、好的生命類憐愍。』

original: ‘ Sādhu kho so, samma sārathi, pabbajito nāma, sādhu dhammacariyā sādhu samacariyā sādhu kusalakiriyā sādhu puññakiriyā sādhu avihiṃsā sādhu bhūtānukampā.
content: 『親愛的御車手！那位名為出家者，[[sādhu#好]]！有好的法行、好的正行、好的善行為、好的福業、好的無加害、好的生命類憐愍。

original: Tena hi, samma sārathi, yena so pabbajito tena rathaṃ pesehī’ ti.
content: 親愛的御車手！那樣的話，請你驅車去那位出家者處。』

original: ‘ Evaṃ, devā’ ti kho, bhikkhave, sārathi vipassissa kumārassa paṭissutvā yena so pabbajito tena rathaṃ pesesi.
content: 『是的，殿下！』比丘們！御車手回答毘婆尸王子後，驅車去那位出家者處。

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro taṃ pabbajitaṃ etadavoca–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸王子對那位出家者說這個：

original: ‘ tvaṃ pana, samma, kiṃkato, sīsampi te na yathā aññesaṃ, vatthānipi te na yathā aññesan’ ti?
content: 『親愛的！那麼，你怎麼了？你的頭不如同其他人的，你的衣服也不如同其他人的。』

original: ‘ Ahaṃ kho, deva, pabbajito nāmā’ ti.
content: 『殿下！我名為出家者。』

original: ‘ Kiṃ pana tvaṃ, samma, pabbajito nāmā’ ti?
content: 『親愛的！那麼，怎樣這位名為出家者？』

original: ‘ Ahaṃ kho, deva, pabbajito nāma, sādhu dhammacariyā sādhu samacariyā sādhu kusalakiriyā sādhu puññakiriyā sādhu avihiṃsā sādhu bhūtānukampā’ ti.
content: 『殿下！我名為出家者，有好的法行、好的正行、好的善行為、好的福業、好的無加害、好的生命類憐愍。』

original: ‘ Sādhu kho tvaṃ, samma, pabbajito nāma sādhu dhammacariyā sādhu samacariyā sādhu kusalakiriyā sādhu puññakiriyā sādhu avihiṃsā sādhu bhūtānukampā’ ti.
content: 『親愛的！你名為出家者，好！有好的法行、好的正行、好的善行為、好的福業、好的無加害、好的生命類憐愍。』(53)

original: Bodhisattapabbajjā
content: [[bodhisatta#菩薩]]的出家

original: 54.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro sārathiṃ āmantesi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸王子召喚御車手：

original: ‘ tena hi, samma sārathi, rathaṃ ādāya itova antepuraṃ paccaniyyāhi.
content: 『親愛的御車手！那樣的話，取車子後請你就從這裡朝內宮出發，

original: Ahaṃ pana idheva kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmī’ ti.
content: 然而，我就在這裡剃除髮鬚、裹上袈裟衣後，將從在家出家成為無家者。』

original: ‘ Evaṃ, devā’ ti kho, bhikkhave, sārathi vipassissa kumārassa paṭissutvā rathaṃ ādāya tatova antepuraṃ paccaniyyāsi.
content: 『是的，殿下！』比丘們！御車手回答毘婆尸王子後，取車子後就從那裡朝內宮出，

original: Vipassī pana kumāro tattheva kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji.
content: 然而，毘婆尸王子就在那裡剃除髮鬚、裹上袈裟衣後，從在家出家成為無家者。(54)

original: Mahājanakāyaanupabbajjā
content: 大群人的跟隨出家

original: 55.‘‘ Assosi kho, bhikkhave, bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā mahājanakāyo caturāsīti pāṇasahassāni–
content: 比丘們！在邦都馬低王都中大群人：八萬四千生類聽聞：

original: ‘ vipassī kira kumāro kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito’ ti.
content: 『毘婆尸王子剃除髮鬚、裹上袈裟衣後，從在家出家成為無家者。』

original: Sutvāna tesaṃ etadahosi–
content: 聽聞後，他們想這個：

original: ‘ na hi nūna so orako dhammavinayo, na sā orakā[ orikā( sī. syā.)] pabbajjā, yattha vipassī kumāro kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
content: 『那確定不是低級的法律；那確定不是低級的出家：毘婆尸王子剃除髮鬚、裹上袈裟衣後，從在家出家成為無家者之處。

original: Vipassīpi nāma kumāro kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati, kimaṅgaṃ[ kimaṅga( sī.)] pana mayan’ ti.
content: 如果毘婆尸王子確實都剃除髮鬚、裹上袈裟衣後，從在家出家成為無家者，更何況是我們。』

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, so bhikkhave, mahājanakāyo[ mahājanakāyo( syā.)] caturāsīti pāṇasahassāni kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā vipassiṃ bodhisattaṃ agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitaṃ anupabbajiṃsu.
content: 比丘們！那時，那個大群人：八萬四千生類剃除髮鬚、裹上袈裟衣後，跟隨毘婆尸菩薩出家：從在家出家成為無家者。

original: Tāya sudaṃ, bhikkhave, parisāya parivuto vipassī bodhisatto gāmanigamajanapadarājadhānīsu cārikaṃ carati.
content: 毘婆尸菩薩被那群群眾圍繞，在村落、城鎮、地方、王都中進行遊行。(55)

original: 56.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi–
content: 比丘們！那時，獨處、[[paṭisallāṇa#獨坐]]的毘婆尸菩薩這樣心的深思生起：

original: ‘ na kho metaṃ[ na kho panetaṃ( syā.)] patirūpaṃ yohaṃ ākiṇṇo viharāmi, yaṃnūnāhaṃ eko gaṇamhā vūpakaṭṭho vihareyyan’ ti.
content: 『這對我是不適當的：凡我住於雜亂的，讓我住於從群眾遠離的單獨者。』

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bodhisatto aparena samayena eko gaṇamhā vūpakaṭṭho vihāsi , aññeneva tāni caturāsīti pabbajitasahassāni agamaṃsu, aññena maggena vipassī bodhisatto.
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩過些時候住於從群眾遠離的單獨者：那群八萬四千出家者就另外地走，毘婆尸菩薩以另一道路。(56)

original: Bodhisattaabhiniveso
content: 菩薩的執持

original: 57.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa vāsūpagatassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi–
content: 比丘們！那時，進入住處獨處的、獨坐的毘婆尸菩薩這樣心的深思生起：

original: ‘ kicchaṃ vatāyaṃ loko āpanno, jāyati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca[ jiyyati ca miyyati ca( ka.)] cavati ca upapajjati ca, atha ca panimassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ nappajānāti jarāmaraṇassa, kudāssu nāma imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyissati jarāmaraṇassā’ ti?
content: 『唉！這個世間確實已陷入苦難：被生、衰老、死去、死沒、再生，然而，不知道這老死苦的[[nissāraṇīyā dhātuyo#出離]]，什麼時候這老死苦的出離才將被知道？』[SN.12.4]

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

original: ‘ kimhi nu kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti, kiṃpaccayā jarāmaraṇan’ ti?
content: 『在什麼存在時老死存在呢？以什麼[[paccayā#為緣]]有老死(而老死存在)？』

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo–

original: ‘ jātiyā kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇan’ ti.
content: 『在生存在時老死存在；以生為緣有老死。』

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

original: ‘ kimhi nu kho sati jāti hoti, kiṃpaccayā jātī’ ti?
content: 『在什麼存在時生存在呢？以什麼為緣有生？』

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩從如理作意，以慧有現觀：

original: ‘ bhave kho sati jāti hoti, bhavapaccayā jātī’ ti.
content: 『在有存在時生存在；以有為緣有生。』

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

original: ‘ kimhi nu kho sati bhavo hoti, kiṃpaccayā bhavo’ ti?
content: 『在什麼存在時有存在呢？以什麼為緣有有呢？』

content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩從如理作意，以慧有現觀：

original: ‘ upādāne kho sati bhavo hoti, upādānapaccayā bhavo’ ti.
content: 『在取存在時有存在；以取為緣有有。』

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

original: ‘ kimhi nu kho sati upādānaṃ hoti, kiṃpaccayā upādānan’ ti?

original: ‘ vedanāya kho sati taṇhā hoti, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā’ ti.
content: 『在受存在時渴愛存在；以受為緣有渴愛。』

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

original: ‘ kimhi nu kho sati vedanā hoti, kiṃpaccayā vedanā’ ti?
content: 『在什麼存在時受存在呢？以什麼為緣有受呢？』

original: ‘ phasse kho sati vedanā hoti, phassapaccayā vedanā’ ti.
content: 『在觸存在時受存在；以觸為緣有受。』

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩從如理作意，以慧有現觀：

original: ‘ viññāṇe kho sati nāmarūpaṃ hoti, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpan’ ti.

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

original: ‘ kimhi nu kho sati viññāṇaṃ hoti, kiṃpaccayā viññāṇan’ ti?

content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩從如理作意，以慧有現觀：

original: ‘ nāmarūpe kho sati viññāṇaṃ hoti, nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇan’ ti.
content: 『在名色存在時識存在；以名色為緣有識。』(57)

content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

original: ‘ paccudāvattati kho idaṃ viññāṇaṃ nāmarūpamhā, nāparaṃ gacchati.
content: 『這個識從名色回轉，不更進一步走[SN.12.65]，

original: Ettāvatā jāyetha vā jiyyetha vā miyyetha vā cavetha vā upapajjetha vā, yadidaṃ nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā , taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
content: 就這個範圍，會被生，或會被衰老，或會死去，或會死沒，或會再生，即：以名色為緣有識；以識為緣有名色；以名色為緣有六處；以六處為緣有觸；以觸為緣有受；以受為緣有渴愛；以渴愛為緣有取；以取為緣有有；以有為緣有生；以生為緣老、死、愁、悲、苦、憂、[[upāyāsā#絕望]]生成，

original: Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti’.
content: 這樣是這整個[[dukkhakkhandhassa#苦蘊]]的[[samudayaṃ#集]]。(58)

original: 59.‘‘‘ Samudayo samudayo’ ti kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.
content: 『[[samudayaṃ#集]]！集！』比丘們！在以前不曾聽聞的諸法上，毘婆尸菩薩的眼生起，智生起，慧生起，明生起，[[cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi#光生起]]。(59)

original: 60.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

original: ‘ kimhi nu kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodho’ ti?
content: 『在什麼不存在時老死不存在呢？以什麼滅有老死滅(而老死滅存在)呢？』

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo –

original: ‘ jātiyā kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodho’ ti.
content: 『在生不存在時老死不存在；以生滅有老死滅。』

original: ‘ bhave kho asati jāti na hoti, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho’ ti.
content: 『在有不存在時生不存在；以有滅有生滅。』

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

original: ‘ kimhi nu kho asati bhavo na hoti, kissa nirodhā bhavanirodho’ ti?
content: 『在什麼不存在時有不存在呢？以什麼滅有有滅呢？』

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo–

original: ‘ upādāne kho asati bhavo na hoti, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho’ ti.
content: 『在取不存在時有不存在；以取滅有有滅。』

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

original: ‘ kimhi nu kho asati upādānaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā upādānanirodho’ ti?
content: 『在什麼不存在時取不存在呢？以什麼滅有取滅呢？』

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩從如理作意，以慧有現觀：

original: ‘ taṇhāya kho asati upādānaṃ na hoti, taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho’ ti.
content: 『在渴愛不存在時取不存在；以渴愛滅有取滅。』

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

original: ‘ kimhi nu kho asati taṇhā na hoti, kissa nirodhā taṇhānirodho’ ti?
content: 『在什麼不存在時渴愛不存在呢？以什麼滅有渴愛滅呢？』

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo –
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩從如理作意，以慧有現觀：

original: ‘ vedanāya kho asati taṇhā na hoti, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho’ ti.

content: 『在什麼不存在時受不存在呢？以什麼滅有受滅呢？』

content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩從如理作意，以慧有現觀：

original: ‘ phasse kho asati vedanā na hoti, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho’ ti.
content: 『在觸不存在時受不存在；以觸滅有受滅。』

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩從如理作意，以慧有現觀：

original: ‘ saḷāyatane kho asati phasso na hoti, saḷāyatananirodhā phassanirodho’ ti.
content: 『在六處不存在時觸不存在；以六處滅有觸滅。』

original: ‘ ‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩想這個：

original: ‘ adhigato kho myāyaṃ maggo sambodhāya yadidaṃ– nāmarūpanirodhā viññāṇanirodho, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho, nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodho, saḷāyatananirodhā phassanirodho, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho, taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.

original: Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti’.
content: 這樣是這整個苦蘊的[[nirodhaṃ#滅]]。』(61)

original: 62.‘‘‘ Nirodho nirodho’ ti kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.
content: 『滅！滅！』比丘們！在以前不曾聽聞的諸法上，毘婆尸菩薩的眼生起，智生起，慧生起，明生起，光生起。(62)

original: 63.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bodhisatto aparena samayena pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī vihāsi–
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩過些時候在五取蘊上住於[[udayabbayānupassī#隨看生滅的]]：

original: ‘ iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo;
content: 『像這樣是色，像這樣是色的集，像這樣是色的滅沒；

original: iti vedanā, iti vedanāya samudayo, iti vedanāya atthaṅgamo;
content: 像這樣是受，像這樣是受的集，像這樣是受的滅沒；

original: iti saññā, iti saññāya samudayo, iti saññāya atthaṅgamo;
content: 像這樣是想，像這樣是想的集，像這樣是想的滅沒；

original: iti saṅkhārā, iti saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo, iti saṅkhārānaṃ atthaṅgamo;
content: 像這樣是諸行，像這樣是諸行的集，像這樣是諸行的滅沒；

original: iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo’ ti, tassa pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato na cirasseva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccī’’ ti.
content: 像這樣是識，像這樣是識的集，這樣是識的滅沒。』當在五取蘊上住於隨看生滅的時，不久就不執取後心從諸[[avassuto#漏]]被解脫。(63)

original: Dutiyabhāṇavāro .
content: 第二誦品[終了]。
